title: Terms Schedule — The Paid Share on Repeated Guarantee Shortfalls, Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# The Paid Share on Repeated Shortfalls

Schedule fixing the share of a shortfall the company pays on a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions where shortfalls have already been paid in the year. The repeat step is 10 percentage points and the further step 20 percentage points.

## Schedule

Where exactly one shortfall has been paid on the subscription in the twelve months ending on the day of the payment, the paid share is the tier's shortfall share less the repeat step. Where two or more shortfalls have been paid on the subscription in those twelve months, the paid share is the tier's shortfall share less the further step. In every other case the paid share is the tier's shortfall share.

## Table

| Shortfall payments made on the subscription in the 12 months ending on the day of the payment | Paid share |
|---|---|
| none | the tier's shortfall share |
| exactly one | the tier's shortfall share less 10 |
| two or more | the tier's shortfall share less 20 |

Each payment on the subscription's guarantee record carries the day it was made; that day places it inside or outside the twelve months.

## Illustration (hypothetical, a tier whose shortfall share is 75 percent)

| Payments already made in the window | Paid share |
|---|---|
| none | 75 percent |
| one | 65 percent |
| three | 55 percent |
